action_space.semantics: ordered composition of 24 bits using the frozen segmented carry-select generator

uniform_random_structural.policy: uniformly sample unseen masks from the complete 23-bit mask space without replacement

evolution_structural.archive_update: append each new evaluated candidate before choosing the next candidate

claude_structural.starting_context: only the 8 shared seed observations plus the frozen benchmark/action-space description
claude_structural.adaptive_context: the shared seed plus only this algorithm's own previous query results
claude_structural.action: select exactly one previously unseen 23-bit boundary mask
claude_structural.rtl_generation: none; the same frozen structural generator used by random and evolution produces RTL
claude_structural.invalid_or_duplicate_model_outputs: do not consume an EDA query; record and request a replacement
